summary: Midget Peak lookout, St. Joe National Forest: 1929 cabin and platform tower, unbuilt 1941 L-4 cab, 2021 fire; tower in ruins at a 2022 visit.

facts.design: cabin and platform tower on the west point; an L-4 cab was planned but never built
facts.status_note: Platform tower reported standing in 2019; a 2022 visit found the site burned after the 2021 Stateline Fire and the tower in ruins

visit.trail_note: Hike-in. The 2022 visit report describes an approach of about 3.5 miles and mentions no closure or permit.

events.note: Cabin on the west point and a platform tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Fire Lookout Association gives 1958 and Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1942. Neither source explains the gap, so the story gives both dates and does not choose.

sources.title: Cabin Architecture
sources.publisher: Keeping Watch, University of Idaho Library

notes_for_editor: Brief kind ground matches the Forest Fire Lookout Association list, though the sources describe a cabin plus a platform tower; no correction proposed. No staffing sources exist. Access level left out: no source gives a status, and the only visit report mentions no closure. The site's condition rests on one 2022 visit report. Abandonment year conflicts (1942 vs 1958) are left open.
